'''''Callophyllis''''' is a red algae genus in the family [[Kallymeniaceae]]. Several species are exploited as [[edible seaweed]]s under the common name '''carola''', most commonly ''[[Callophyllis variegata]]''.<ref>{{cite journal |author1=Arakaki, Natalia |author2=Alveal, Krisler |author3=Ramírez, María Eliana |author4=Fredericq, Suzanne |year=2011 |title=The genus Callophyllis (Kallymeniaceae, Rhodophyta) from the central-south Chilean coast (33° to 41° S), with the description of two new species |journal=Revista Chilena de Historia Natural |volume=84 |issue=4 |pages=481–499 |doi=10.4067/S0716-078X2011000400002 |issn=0716-078X |url=http://www.scielo.cl/scielo.php?pid=S0716-078X2011000400002&script=sci_arttext |accessdate=3 December 2012|doi-access=free }}</ref>
